text:
Detroit arrives on the second night of a back-to-back, fresh off a 5-3 win at FLA that ended the Panthers' three-game winning streak and gave Carter Mazur his first NHL goal. The Red Wings are playing without Dylan Larkin (suspension), and Alex DeBrincat has moved onto the line beside Raymond and Arvidsson in his absence. Tampa Bay, rested for two days, lost 5-4 in a shootout at NSH after the Predators trailed in the third period. Jake Guentzel is on a four-game point streak, and Nikita Kucherov made headlines Monday with his trade request.

The teams look even at five on five, each owning 55% of the expected goals (the quality of chances). TBL creates more, 3.62 per 60 minutes against 3.26, while DET has been better than its record, with Finishing costing it 5.8 goals. DET's 4.0 penalties a game keep feeding the other power play, though TBL's penalty kill has allowed less. Our numbers lean TBL, 3.33 goals to 2.86.

In goal, projected starters John Gibson (DET) and Andrei Vasilevskiy (TBL) are both below expected this season, at -6.15 and -2.58 goals saved above expected. Last year they were at +10.11 and +23.15. Watch Emmitt Finnie, a 201st overall pick with 10 points in 10 games, and Lucas Raymond for Detroit. For Tampa, our numbers like Brandon Hagel (43% to score) and Guentzel (40%).
